# ferriskey_authz_template (Resource)

Manages a Cedar policy template of a FerrisKey realm. A template is Cedar text with `?principal` and/or `?resource` slots that `ferriskey_authz_policy` resources instantiate through `links`. A template cannot be deleted while a policy links it (the API answers 409), so linked policies must reference the template to be destroyed first. The Cedar text is stored verbatim. Writes to a realm's authorization rules are serialized by the provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_authz_template" "role_can_read" {
  realm       = ferriskey_authz_schema.main.realm
  name        = "role-can-read"
  description = "Lets a role read documents"
  source      = "permit(principal in ?principal, action == App::Action::\"read\", resource);"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Template name, unique within the realm. Letters, digits, `_`, `-`, `.` and `:` only (max 128 characters).
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm the template belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `source` (String) Cedar template text containing `?principal` and/or `?resource` slots.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Template description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{uuid}`.
- `template_id` (String) Server-assigned UUID of the template.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_authz_template.role_can_read acme/4b2d7f90-1111-2222-3333-444455556666
```
